entries.title: Psalms 58:1
segments:
Do ye judge uprightly; the reference is to the decisions of wicked rulers who were the enemies and persecutors of David. 
 
No iniquity is more hateful than that which is practised under the cover of law.

entries.title: Psalms 58:2
segments: Ye weigh the violence of your hands; dispense violence instead of justice.

entries.title: Psalms 58:3
segments: As soon as they be born; at the commencement of their course of moral action, they naturally depart from God.
Men are from the beginning of their moral existence prone to evil as the sparks to fly upward, or the waters to run downward.

entries.title: Psalms 58:4
segments: Like the deaf adder; as this is insensible to all the words of the charmer, so are they to all attempts to recall them from their wicked ways.

entries.title: Psalms 58:6
segments: Break their teeth; disable them from doing mischief.

entries.title: Psalms 58:7
segments:
Them; the arrows. 
 
  As cut in pieces; broken, or blunted, so that they can do no execution.

entries.title: Psalms 58:8
segments: Which melteth; probably an allusion to the slime secreted from its own body which the snail leaves in its path.

entries.title: Psalms 58:9
segments:
Feel the thorns; feel their heat.  Kindling a fire of thorns under their pots is a figure for plotting wicked schemes, which God will carry away as with a tempest, before their accomplishment. 
 
  Shall take them away; shall sweep away the thorns with a tempest, as the original word implies, and thus put an end, so to speak, to the cooking of their mischievous plots. 
 
  Both living, and in his wrath; the literal meaning of the original, seems to be that God's wrath will take away the thorns while yet living, that is, yet green and unburned, before the pots have felt the heat from their flame.  Others prefer to render, Whether raw, or cooked; in other words, whether their schemes are immature, or now complete and ripening to accomplishment. 
 
The destruction of the ungodly will be sudden and complete; they will be taken away in the midst of their wicked plans.

entries.title: Psalms 58:10
segments: Wash his feet in the blood of the wicked; in token of triumph.
